purpose: Require structural conclusions involving Cap(t), Sigma(t), overload, viability or collapse thresholds to be checked against declared alternative Cap(t) specifications.

decision_rule.CAP_ROBUST: All declared alternative forms pass the robustness thresholds against the primary form.
decision_rule.CAP_SPEC_SENSITIVE: At least one declared alternative form fails a robustness threshold. Structural conclusions remain specification-sensitive.

normative_status: A result depending entirely on one Cap(t) form cannot be considered structurally robust.
